items.description: An item in the merchant's inventory catalog.

itemId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the item.

imagePath.description: Path to the item's full-size image, if one is attached.

thumbnailPath.description: Path to the item's thumbnail image, if one is attached.

unitPrice.description: A pair of prices for the same amount under dual pricing: what the customer pays with cash and what they pay with card. When dual pricing is disabled both values are equal.

cash.description: Price paid with cash, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

card.description: Price paid with card, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

unitPrice.title: PricePair

priceType.description: How the item is priced: FIXED (catalog price), VARIABLE (price entered at sale time) or PER_UNIT (price per unit of measure, e.g. per pound).

unitType.description: Unit of measure for PER_UNIT items; null for other price types.

oneOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

oneOf.title: UnitType

allOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

allOf.title: UnitType

allOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

allOf.title: UnitType

allOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

allOf.description: Unit of measure for items sold per unit (priceType PER_UNIT). The 'value' discriminator is one of 'Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz' or 'Custom'; for 'Custom' the 'name' field carries the merchant-defined unit label.

name.description: Display name of the unit. Equals the discriminator for built-in units ('Kg', 'Lb', 'Oz'); a merchant-defined label for 'Custom' units.

allOf.title: UnitType

isEBT.description: Whether the item is eligible for EBT (Electronic Benefit Transfer) payment.

items.description: A category in the merchant's inventory. Items may belong to one or more categories.

categoryId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the category.

lastModified.description: When the category was last modified (ISO-8601).

isDeleted.description: Whether the category has been soft-deleted. Deleted categories are only returned when explicitly requested via includeDeleted.

items.title: CategoryDto

charges.description: Charges (extra fees) applied to the item.

items.description: A charge (tax or extra fee) that can be applied to items, e.g. sales tax or a bottle deposit.

chargeId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the charge.

chargeAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the item price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Charge value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 725 = 7.25%) for PERCENTAGE charges, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED charges.

isDefault.description: Whether the charge is applied by default to items that opt into the merchant's default charges.

lastModified.description: When the charge was last modified (ISO-8601).

isDeleted.description: Whether the charge has been soft-deleted. Deleted charges are only returned when explicitly requested via includeDeleted.

items.title: ChargeDto

isChargesDefault.description: Whether the merchant's default charges are applied to the item in addition to the explicitly listed ones.

productCode.description: Product code of the item (e.g. UPC/barcode value).

itemCost.description: The merchant's cost for one unit of the item, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

quantity.description: Deprecated integer stock counter. Use stockQuantity instead.

stockQuantity.description: Current stock quantity. Supports fractional values for per-unit items (e.g. 2.5 lb).

trackInventory.description: Whether CorePOS tracks stock for this item and decrements it on each sale.

dualPricingBasePriceType.description: Which side of the price pair (CASH or CARD) the merchant entered as the base price; the other side is derived from the dual-pricing rate.

lastModified.description: When the item was last modified (ISO-8601).

isAvailable.description: Whether the item is currently available for sale on the register.

isDeleted.description: Whether the item has been soft-deleted. Deleted items are only returned when explicitly requested via includeDeleted.

items.title: ItemDto
